name: Sam
bio: New to the area and trying to find the good walks. I make a decent flat white and a very mediocre curry.

prompts.question: My simple pleasures
prompts.answer: Finding a bench in the sun that nobody else has found yet.

prompts.question: I am looking for
prompts.answer: Someone who is up for a long walk and a longer conversation.

prompts.question: Dating me is like
prompts.answer: A reliable Sunday. Low drama, good snacks.
